According to the official **Semrush Terms of Service** (as well as its Website Terms of Use and Privacy Policy):
> *"These Terms of Service (the “Agreement”) are a legally binding agreement between the user or subscriber of the Services (“Customer” or “you”) and **Semrush Inc.**, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 800 Boylston Street, Suite 2475, Boston, MA 02199, USA (“Semrush”, “SEMRush”, “we”, or “us”). ... The “Services” consist of a suite of online marketing and management tools and toolkits located at https://www.semrush.com/ or another URL we designate (the “Website”)..."*
